import numpy as np
from core.base.base_model import BaseModel

class SpringMassModel(BaseModel):
    def __init__(self, scene_config):
        params = scene_config.get("physical_params", {})
        self.mass = params.get("mass", 1.0)
        self.spring_constant = params.get("spring_constant", 2.0)
        self.damping_coefficient = params.get("damping_coefficient", 0.5)
        self.scene_config = scene_config

    def get_initial_state(self, x_grid=None):
        init = self.scene_config.get("initial_state", {})
        state_names = self.scene_config.get("state_names", [])
        return np.array([init.get(name, 0.0) for name in state_names])

    def rhs(self, t, state, control, x_grid=None):
        # Unpack state according to state_names order
        position, velocity = state
        # Unpack control according to control_names order
        force = control[0]

        # Spring-mass-damper dynamics
        dx = velocity
        dv = (force - self.spring_constant * position - self.damping_coefficient * velocity) / self.mass

        return np.array([dx, dv])

    def validate_state(self, state):
        return True
